features.name: share_comments_quoting_op
features.definition: What proportion of the counter-argument comments directly quote wording from the original post?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of comments by other users. For each comment decide whether it contains a direct quotation (verbatim or near-verbatim copied wording, e.g. in quotation marks or blockquote '>' format) of text that appears in the OP's title or argument. Quotations of other sources, paraphrases without copied wording, and quotation marks used for scare quotes or other-speaker text not found in the OP text do not count. Ignore quotes that are only OP view-change/delta-award announcements or post-outcome resolution reports. Output = (number of comments with such a quotation) / (total number of comments), a number in [0,1]. Empty list gives null; missing or malformed input gives null.

h0: share_comments_quoting_op has no association with the likelihood of OP view change.
h1: Higher share_comments_quoting_op is associated with a higher likelihood of OP view change.
note: Operational assumptions: "frequently embedding" is measured as the share of available comments with a direct OP quotation; "lacking explicit textual anchoring" is the low end of this continuous share (zero share), not a separately defined group. Quotation verification uses current title/argument, which may contain edits or outcome announcements; no timing information is available. Comments are not necessarily from distinct commenters. Association only, not causal.
